name: New skill proposal
about: Propose a new skill for the store

**Skill name**
Proposed kebab-case name, e.g. `meeting-notes`.

**What it does**
One or two sentences.

**Trigger phrases**
The phrases a user would say to invoke it.

**Data it needs (if any)**
What files or MCP servers it reads. Confirm it ships no real data — only
fictional `examples/`.

**Why it belongs here**
Who benefits and how it stays self-contained.
